text: Several visitors reported difficulty finding the library due to incorrect or misleading location information on Google Maps, which led some to remote farmland instead of the site. The timed entry system caused frustration for some guests, especially those without reservations or needing to change tickets, with reports of limited customer support. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and the surrounding landscape, some criticized the AI features and found the food options unsatisfactory. Staff were generally described as kind, but issues with crowding and queues were noted by a smaller number of visitors. Overall, the average rating remains high, but navigation and customer service need attention.

The timed-entry system received criticism for its inflexibility, as some guests were turned away for not having reservations despite low visitor numbers. On a more positive note, some reviews mentioned interactive exhibits and the kindness of staff, though food quality was questioned by at least one visitor. Wayfinding and signage issues were also noted but less frequently.

Some guests expressed frustration with the timed entry system and lack of flexibility, noting that reservations were required even when the library was not busy. There were also complaints about limited customer service support, including slow or unhelpful responses to inquiries. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and the surrounding landscape, a few criticized the quality of food options and the use of AI features. Overall, the average rating remains high, but navigation, ticketing policies, and customer assistance are areas needing attention.
